name: motion
description: Turn what a motion-graphics video is for into a rendered mp4 made to the craft its use calls for: /elicit reads the request back at the level the person's own words show and the build starts at once without waiting on it (an interrupt stops a wrong reading), on HyperFrames where it is installed, then the mp4 is rendered and shown to approve or change, with /sketch or /preview from it where a change must be seen to be judged (/motion)
